themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems or users.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, including analysis of their effectiveness and security.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discussion of AI-powered platforms and tools designed to facilitate and enhance various aspects of research, from data analysis to paper synthesis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, data, or research into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Topics related to AI-generated or simulated users, personas, or performers used for testing, content creation, or market analysis.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Content focusing on how AI is used to analyze user data, market trends, and other datasets to derive actionable insights.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools and models for research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussion on how AI is affecting job markets, skill requirements, and the nature of work across various industries.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Articles exploring the use of AI for creating text, images, music, or other forms of content, with a focus on design and creative applications.

themes.name: AI design & research
themes.description: Discussions on how AI is integrated into the design process and user research methodologies, affecting workflows and outcomes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
